record.prompt: Please rebuild the price page with site/build.js and tell me how many products it lists and which listed product is the cheapest. Don't modify build.js.

memory_calls.input: ls -R site | head -50 && cat site/build.js && memcue search "site build.js price page" 2>&1 | head -30

record.final_answer:
I rebuilt the page, and it lists **6 products**. The cheapest one listed is the **Fable pencil set at 7.60**.

The 6 listed products are Anchor mug (14.50), Bramble journal (8.90), Dune tote bag (24.00), Fable pencil set (7.60), Gale scarf (31.50) and Ivy plant pot (13.20).

The data file has 10 products, but `build.js` only lists the ones marked active. Juniper soap (5.90) and Ember tea tin (7.20) cost less than the pencil set, but they're inactive, so the page leaves them out.

I ran `node build.js` from inside `site/`, because the script looks for its files relative to the folder you run it from. It wrote the page to `site/public/prices.html`. I didn't change `build.js`.
